manual_section_cross_link: Operationalization Manual Section C — Applied Dramatism Cases / Methodological Templates (parallel to Calleja Appendix in the In-Game pipeline)
summary: Six applied-dramatism cases drawn from five Burke source units, abstracted into dissertation-deployable methodological templates at five analytical scales (single-text drama, single-text drama with reversed ratio, single-text lyric, political-text / collective document, single-poet oeuvre). A seventh apparatus (the trope-pentad interaction matrix from GM-13) is recorded as a parallel methodological lens that overlays each of the six cases.
content_filter_compliance: No verbatim string of 25 or more consecutive words from Burke is reproduced. Game titles, character names, and analytic terms are referenced by locus only.

dramatism_application_cases.case_label: Ibsen, *An Enemy of the People* (single-text drama, scene-act paradigm)

pentad_deployment.scene: Five distinct stage-scenes (sitting-room Acts I-II, editorial office Act III, semi-public room Act IV, disordered study Act V); each scene-shift qualifies the act that occurs within it.
pentad_deployment.act: Stockmann's progressive five-act act of public truth-telling; the plot as a single composite act characterized as an internality directed outwards.
pentad_deployment.agent: Dr. Stockmann + the family circle as aspects of his own identity (the closing standing-alone pronouncement is modified by the agents physically present).
pentad_deployment.agency: Public address, the press, the town meeting — implicit means of the act of denunciation.
pentad_deployment.purpose: Founding a renewed community out of solitary withdrawal.

ratios_deployed: scene-act (master): each act's quality matches the room/setting it occurs in
scene-agent (closing): the disordered study at Act V is bidirectionally readable as scenic property or as reflection of the agent's post-conflict state
act-agent (closing): standing-alone act framed and modified by present agents
symbolic_action_sequence: Act I-II — bourgeois sitting-room frames bourgeois plot
Act III — editorial-office gives forensic coloration to the peripety
Act IV — semi-public room mirrors semi-public character of the appeal
Act V — disordered study mirrors post-conflict agent-state
Closing pronouncement modified by the family scene present
methodological_template_steps: Identify each scene-shift in the text
Map which act occurs in each scene and verify scene-act ratio coherence
Mark the structural fulcrum (here: peripety at Act III)
Read the closing scene bidirectionally (scenic property OR agent-state)
Read the protagonist's pronouncement against the scene physically present at the moment of speech
Diagnose the whole as a single composite act characterized by a single motive-vector
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: At single-game scale: treat each level / mission / area-shift as a Burkean scene-shift; map the player's permitted/required acts to each scene; identify the structural peripety (mid-game reversal, betrayal beat, gating event); read the endgame scene bidirectionally — is the final environment scenic property, or is it a mirror of the player-character's transformed state? Diagnose the entire run as a single composite act whose motive-vector is legible only at the whole-game scale.

dramatism_application_cases.case_label: O'Neill, *Mourning Becomes Electra* (single-text drama, ratio-reversal demonstration)

source_loci.json_block: literary_examples + Further Instances of These Ratios section

pentad_deployment.scene: The shut-in house with nailed shutters and discarded flowers; the constructed scene that becomes a motivating principle
pentad_deployment.act: Lavinia's command to nail the shutters (act constructing scene); subsequent automaton-march into the house (scene-commanded act)
pentad_deployment.agency: Verbal command; nails and shutters as instruments
pentad_deployment.purpose: Self-immurement; closure of the tragic trilogy

ratios_deployed: scene-act REVERSED (act-scene-act): act produces scene which produces further act
scene-act degenerate case (action-to-motion): the automaton-march as boundary where action collapses into mere motion (Burke's anti-behaviorist diagnostic)
symbolic_action_sequence: Scene physically modified (shutters nailed, flowers discarded)
Modified scene becomes operative motivational principle
Action collapses into motion at the boundary
methodological_template_steps: Identify acts that explicitly construct scene
Identify subsequent acts that the constructed scene commands
Test for ratio-reversibility (does the text run scene→act, act→scene, or both?)
Diagnose boundary cases where action degenerates into motion (the behaviorist-metaphysical truncation)
Mark the dramatistic-vs-behaviorist distinction in the text
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: At single-game scale, ratio-reversal axis: identify player-acts that physically reshape the gameworld (terraforming, base-building, structural choices in immersive sims) and trace how the reshaped world then commands subsequent acts. Diagnose boundary cases where player-action collapses into player-motion — grinding, AFK farming, macro-driven inputs, idle-game tick-collection — as Burke's action-to-motion degenerate case. The action/motion distinction is the dissertation's load-bearing critique of behaviorist game-telemetry that reduces player-action to keystroke-frequency.

dramatism_application_cases.scale: political-text / collective document / theory-corpus (extensible to design-theory corpus)

pentad_deployment.scene: Constitution-behind-the-Constitution as scenic ultimate; substance as ground of motive (move 1)
pentad_deployment.act: Constitutional enactment as partial public act embedded in wider scene (move 3); Declaration / Constitution as paradigm acts
pentad_deployment.agent: Constitutions addressed by Agents (I/we) to Agents (you); idealistic agent-feature of constitutional texts (move 2); featured-agent diagnoses of Read (anarcho-syndicalist autonomous individual) and Parkes (already-monetarily-socialized agent) (move 7)
pentad_deployment.agency: Judicial review; essentializing-vs-proportional; broad-vs-strict construction; party platforms; lobbies (move 4); Marshall's Marbury argument as Agency-move masquerading as Act-as-mandatory
pentad_deployment.purpose: Ends, ideals, the 'unwritten clause' of reconciliation; constitutive-vs-directive on Peace; religious-vs-secular axis on futurism (move 5)

ratios_deployed: scene-act (master ratio of constitutional theory, move 6): when scene shifts, clauses must mean differently
agent-act (move 7): idealistic Constitution presupposes idealistic agent
agency-purpose (move 8): reform-vs-transform diagnostic
substance-vocabulary deployment (move 9): GM-02 inheritance
four-tropes deployment (move 10): synecdoche / metonymy / irony / metaphor as constitutive operations
diagnostic-not-classificatory featuring (move 11): which term a text FEATURES as locus of motive, not which it omits
methodological_template_steps: Move 1 — Constitution-as-substance: locate the scenic ultimate
Move 2 — Constitutions addressed by Agents to Agents: identify the I/we / you structure
Move 3 — Constitutional enactment as Act: locate the partial public act and its scenic embedding
Move 4 — Procedure as Agency: identify the instruments of interpretation/enforcement
Move 5 — Ends as Purpose: locate the unwritten clauses and ideal-reconciliation claims
Move 6 — Scene-act ratio as master ratio: track how scenic shift forces clausal re-meaning
Move 7 — Agent-act ratio: diagnose the addressee-agent the text presupposes
Move 8 — Agency-purpose ratio: diagnose reform-vs-transform structure
Move 9 — Substance-vocabulary deployment: trace stance-family vocabulary, gerundives-as-ontology, principle-as-substantive-of-wish
Move 10 — Four-tropes deployment: synecdoche (representative anecdote) / metonymy (reduction) / irony (constitutive contradiction) / metaphor (heuristic)
Move 11 — Diagnostic-not-classificatory featuring: name which term the text FEATURES, not which it omits
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: At theory-corpus / design-theory scale: treat each game-design school (ludology, narratology, embodied-cognition game studies, procedural rhetoric, MDA, the Forge essays, design patterns literature, immersive-sim postmortems, F2P live-ops playbooks) as a distinct constitutional project diagnosable by the 11-move walkthrough. Each gets (a) its featured pentad term, (b) its dominant ratios, (c) its God-term (= terminological ultimate substance: e.g., 'engagement,' 'flow,' 'meaningful choice,' 'fairness,' 'fun,' 'ARPDAU'), (d) its strategic choice of circumference (the Constitution-behind-the-Theory), (e) constitutive-vs-admonitory split, (f) essentializing-vs-proportional hermeneutic. Each school becomes recognizable as a partial constitution-text with its own God-term, opponent, and shape of unity-in-diversity.

dramatism_application_cases.case_label: Keats, 'Ode on a Grecian Urn' (single-text lyric)
dramatism_application_cases.source_unit: GM-10 (Symbolic Action in a Poem by Keats)
dramatism_application_cases.scale: single-text lyric (single short text with biographical and cultural-historical substrates)

pentad_deployment.act: Speaker's apostrophic act; figures' arrested acts on the urn; poet's symbolic act of making the poem; the transcendent act split off in stanza III; the urn's incipient act (attitude) in stanza V
pentad_deployment.scene: Urn as frozen-time scene; bodily fever as ground of mental action; deathy-deathless transcendent scene in stanza IV; scene-behind-the-urn at chiasmus; 19th-century romanticism + capitalist-individualist property structure as historical scene
pentad_deployment.agent: Speaker / poet; depicted figures (Bold Lover, fair youth, mysterious priest, marble men and maidens); Keats himself (body as patient, mind as agent); the Urn-as-attitude personified (idealist romantic move)
pentad_deployment.agency: Music / piping; language as mode of action; the urn's visual surface as ekphrastic medium
pentad_deployment.purpose: Oracular truth-beauty identity; transcendence of the romantic split; redemption of bodily suffering by poetic act

ratios_deployed: scene-act (master, as prediction-engine): transcendent act in stanza III demands transcendent scene in stanza IV
scene-agent: urn-as-scene determines depicted agents; romantic-capitalist scene shapes love-death-fixated imagining
act-purpose: symbolic act culminates in oracular identity
act-agent: Christian-romantic inversion (patience as act; mind-as-agent uses bodily-passion-as-act-material)
scene-agency: imagery's no-negation logic constrains agency
symbolic_action_sequence: Stanza I — periodic-to-breathless transmutation; opening motivational hesitation
Stanza II — mystic oxymoron (heard sound surpassed by unheard); motives-behind-motives
Stanza II-III — erotic suspension as arrested pre-ecstasy
Stanza III fulcrum — fever splits: benign spiritual activity parts from malign bodily fever
Stanza IV — scene-act demand satisfied (transcendent scene matches transcendent act)
Stanza IV-V — container-thing-contained inversion (Urn as scene's ground; scene as Urn's ground)
Stanza V — fever-to-chill modulation; cold pastoral as marmorean utterance
Stanza V close — oracle delivered (truth-beauty identity)
Burke's translation — Act is scene / scene act, immediately corrected to Act of an agent via Urn-as-Attitude
methodological_template_steps: State the text's terminal motive-statement (oracle / thesis / end-state)
Walk the text segment by segment with continuous pentad-tagging at the imagistic level
Detect structural fulcra where pentad-clusters split or combine
Deploy the most-foregrounded ratio as a prediction-engine for the next segment
Add biographical / cultural / historical motives as co-active substrates without reducing the symbolic act
Recognize sub-pentadic substance-claims (here: phthisic fever-and-chill as modes of one illness substance)
Terminate with a conceptual translation that exhibits the dramatistic grammar underlying the imagistic resolution
Refuse reductive materialist alternatives that would epiphenomenalize the symbolic act
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: At single-player-trajectory scale: treat one player's recorded session through one game as the equivalent of a single lyric. (i) State the trajectory's terminal motive-statement (the player's end-state — finished / abandoned / mastered / sandboxed); (ii) walk the session segment by segment with continuous pentad-tagging; (iii) detect structural fulcra (death / unlock / story-beat / build-pivot); (iv) deploy the foregrounded ratio as prediction-engine; (v) add biographical / community / cultural substrates without reducing the symbolic act to demographic symptom; (vi) recognize sub-pentadic substance-claims (e.g., difficulty-as-suffering, completion-as-redemption); (vii) end with a conceptual translation exhibiting the dramatistic grammar of the trajectory; (viii) refuse reductive telemetric materialism that treats the trajectory as mere behavior.

dramatism_application_cases.source_unit: GM-12 (Motives and Motifs in the Poetry of Marianne Moore)
dramatism_application_cases.scale: single-author oeuvre (extensible to player-corpus, studio-corpus, community-corpus, designer-career)

pentad_deployment.act: Attentive descriptive observation as Moore's signature act; thing-perceived recoverable as act-perceived (the trunk-as-act case at book p. 498)
pentad_deployment.scene: Descriptive material as scene/background containing the same quality as the final assertive act (scene-act compositional engine of covert lyrics)
pentad_deployment.agent: Moore-as-poet + scene-internal agents (animals, the Irish girl, elephant, unicorn, basilisk); rare overt agent-identification in 'Black Earth'
pentad_deployment.agency: Almost wholly recessive (Moore is not concerned with means-to-ends)
pentad_deployment.purpose: Recessive except in appreciation-as-motive subroutine; appreciation as secular analog of mystical glorification

ratios_deployed: act-agent: attentive act expresses agent-character (signature)
scene-act: description as logical-compositional ground of the assertive act it brackets
scene-agent: catalogue of correspondences (basilisk in basilica)
methodological_template_steps: Step 1 — Choose corpus boundary
Step 2 — Catalog recurrent motifs across the corpus
Step 3 — Identify the underlying motivational substance
Step 4 — Diagnose featured pentad term(s) and recessive terms
Step 5 — Use one internal exhibit as exegetical key to the rest
Step 6 — Test the substance against cross-motif convergence (refutation condition: motifs must converge on a single substance)
Step 7 — Read individual artifacts as 'work in progress' within the corpus (no single artifact is final; each is legible only against cross-corpus sediment)
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: At corpus scale, four sub-deployments paralleling Moore: (a) PLAYER-CORPUS — one player's body of play across multiple games / sessions / years; (b) STUDIO-CORPUS — a studio's released titles read as a single body of work; (c) COMMUNITY-CORPUS — a player community's forum/wiki/clip archive as oeuvre; (d) DESIGNER-CAREER — a single designer's portfolio across studios. Each gets the 7-step procedure: choose boundary, catalog recurrent motifs (mechanics, level-archetypes, character-tropes, build-types, route-patterns, discourse-moves), name the motivational substance, diagnose featured/recessive pentad terms via Calleja-PIM correspondences (kinesthetic → Agency, narrative → Scene+Purpose, shared → Agent), use one paradigmatic artifact as exegetical key, test cross-motif convergence on the substance, read every individual artifact as 'work in progress' within the corpus.

dramatism_application_cases.case_label: Four-Trope Apparatus as Parallel Methodological Overlay
dramatism_application_cases.scale: parallel apparatus — overlays every other case at every scale

pentad_deployment.overlay_metaphor_perspective: Choosing the verb-frame (act), circumference (scene), agent-type-as-frame, instrument-as-frame, end-as-frame
pentad_deployment.overlay_metonymy_reduction: Reducing act to behavior; scene to physical substrate; agent to body/biology; means to technique-shorn-of-meaning; purpose to quantifiable goal-state
pentad_deployment.overlay_synecdoche_representation: Election of one act as standing-for-all; microcosm-macrocosm scene; political representation (avatar-stands-for-player); instrument representing the order it instantiates; end-state representing developmental whole
pentad_deployment.overlay_irony_dialectic: Peripety (A → non-A); scene reframed by perspective of perspectives; consubstantiality with the 'enemy' agent; dialectical interaction producing emergent results; internal fatality of purpose

ratios_deployed: Parallel apparatus — does not deploy pentad ratios but operates on them (each trope is a transformation of pentad terms)
methodological_template_steps: Identify the dominant trope operation in the text/corpus
Cross-reference with featured pentad term: each cell of the 5×4 matrix is a distinct analytic regime
Distinguish classic irony (consubstantiality with the 'enemy') from romantic irony (treating the enemy as not-me)
Use the classic-vs-romantic-irony distinction as the diagnostic of good faith in the analysis
dramatism_application_cases.dissertation_deployment_for_games: Overlay onto every case above: each user-motive analysis names both its featured pentad term and its featured trope-operation, yielding a 5×4 cell matrix the chapter argument moves through. Deployment-regimes: metaphor (gamification rhetoric / skeuomorphic ports of work-school-fitness into 'play'); metonymy (telemetric reduction — player as KDA / MMR / retention-curve / conversion-funnel); synecdoche (avatar / leaderboard / clip as part-for-whole); irony (meta-gaming, speedrunning, glitch-exploitation, emergent-play, consubstantiality of designer and exploiter). Normative criterion: classic irony (the toxic optimizer as rational extension of designed incentive) over romantic irony (the toxic optimizer as not-me).

dissertation_deployment_table.structure: Five scales paralleling Burke's five primary cases, with the trope apparatus as overlay on each

rows.primary_template: 6-step (Ibsen) for forward scene-act analysis OR 5-step (O'Neill) for ratio-reversal / action-vs-motion analysis
rows.pentad_focus: scene-act ratio bidirectionally readable; structural peripety; closing-scene bidirectionality
rows.trope_overlay: select dominant trope per game (action-RPG metaphor / sports-sim metonymy / battle-royale synecdoche / immersive-sim irony)
rows.exemplar_research_question: How does the level-architecture of a single game qualify the acts it permits, and does the endgame scene mirror player-state or remain scenic property?

rows.scale: single player trajectory (one user x one game)
rows.primary_template: 8-step symbolic-action sequence + biographical/cultural substrate without reduction
rows.pentad_focus: scene-act as prediction-engine; structural fulcra; sub-pentadic substance-claims (difficulty-as-suffering, completion-as-redemption)
rows.trope_overlay: diagnose which trope-operation the trajectory enacts (metaphoric — role-playing; metonymic — speedrun-as-time; synecdochic — completionism; ironic — emergent / glitch exploitation)
rows.exemplar_research_question: How does one player's recorded trajectory through a single game perform a dramatistic transformation, and what oracle (terminal motive-statement) does it deliver?

rows.scale: single player corpus (one user x N games)
rows.primary_template: 7-step transfer procedure (boundary / motifs / substance / featured terms / exegetical key / cross-motif test / work-in-progress)
rows.pentad_focus: diagnose featured pentad term across the player's body of play; identify recessive terms
rows.trope_overlay: identify the player's dominant trope-disposition across their corpus
rows.exemplar_research_question: What single motivational substance underwrites this player's recurrent choices across their played-corpus, and which pentad term does it feature?

rows.scale: community / game-corpus (community x game OR studio x titles)
rows.burke_parallel_case: Marianne Moore oeuvre (GM-12) — community-corpus / studio-corpus sub-deployment
rows.pentad_focus: Calleja-PIM correspondences (kinesthetic → Agency, narrative → Scene+Purpose, shared → Agent)
rows.trope_overlay: community discourse-regimes (forum gamification = metaphor; tier-list culture = metonymy; clip/screenshot economy = synecdoche; meta-discourse / patch-cycle critique = irony)
rows.exemplar_research_question: What substance underwrites the recurrent discourse-moves of this community / the recurrent design-choices of this studio?

rows.scale: design-theory corpus (a school / movement of game-design or game-studies thought)
rows.primary_template: 11-move applied-dramatism walkthrough (substance / addressee-agent / enactment / agency / purpose / scene-act / agent-act / agency-purpose / substance-vocabulary / four-tropes / featuring)
rows.pentad_focus: diagnose the featured pentad term of each design-theory school; identify the God-term (engagement / flow / meaningful choice / fairness / ARPDAU); identify the Constitution-behind-the-Theory
rows.trope_overlay: synecdoche (representative-anecdote / paradigm game) / metonymy (operationalization-as-reduction) / irony (constitutive contradictions) / metaphor (heuristic framing)
rows.exemplar_research_question: Which pentad term does ludology / narratology / procedural-rhetoric / embodied-cognition game-studies feature, and what God-term governs each school's analytic terminology?

rows.scale: designer career (one designer x N studios x N titles, career-arc reading)
rows.burke_parallel_case: Hybrid: Moore oeuvre (GM-12) + Keats trajectory (GM-10) — corpus-scale motif tracking with single-text fulcrum analysis at career inflection points
rows.primary_template: 7-step Moore + 8-step Keats hybrid: corpus motif catalogue + fulcrum-by-fulcrum symbolic-action sequence at career-pivot titles
rows.pentad_focus: featured pentad term across the designer's body of work; structural fulcra at studio-transitions / genre-shifts
rows.trope_overlay: designer's signature trope (sandbox metaphor / systems-driven metonymy / archetypal-protagonist synecdoche / subversive irony)
rows.exemplar_research_question: What single motivational substance underwrites this designer's recurrent design-choices across their career, and at which titles does a structural fulcrum split or merge pentad-clusters?

shared_meta_methodological_commitments: Diagnostic-not-classificatory featuring (which term the text features, never which it omits)
Correlation-without-reduction (biographical / cultural / material substrates are co-active, never causally reductive)
Anti-behaviorist commitment (action vs. motion is the load-bearing dramatistic distinction)
Refutation conditions (cross-motif convergence test for corpus-scale; scene-act prediction-engine for single-text)
Substance-as-motive identity (the analytic object is always a substance, never a mere behavior)
